L0@P0: Reductive Groups
L1@P0: J. S. Milne
L2@P0: March 10, 2018, v2.00
L3@P0: Abstract
L4@P0: These notes are a guide to algebraic groups, especially reductive groups, over a
L5@P0: field. Proofs are usually omitted or only sketched. The only prerequisite is a basic
L6@P0: knowledge of commutative algebra and the language of modern algebraic geometry.
L7@P0: My goal in these notes is to write a modern successor to the review articles Springer
L8@P0: 1979, 1994.
L9@P0: Caution: These notes will be revised without warning (the numbering may change).
